scope: read-only path lookup and installed distribution listing; no candidate, model or isolation attack probe

probes.name: public_executable_inventory
args: Get-Command codex,node,docker,podman,wsl,bwrap -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

interpretation: A present executable or installed distribution is not OS isolation qualification. WSL empty listing supplies no executable Linux worker.
